name: dataset tactical: the fixed whole-pitch views for vision, training, validation and test
status: pre-registered Oct 22, before any clip of this run was rendered
commit: the head of render/tactical-views (PR for work package A) given in the render manifest's render_commit; after the merge, `git diff <render_commit> <merge commit> -- ninety/render web/render` must be empty, or the clips are re-rendered
why: The broadcast follows the ball, so vision cannot see players off its screen. The two fixed tactical lenses (renderer 0.5.15, `--views tactical`, docs/GROUNDING.md V7) hold the whole pitch; the detector is fine-tuned on them (docs/eval/finetune-tactical/PLAN.md).

seeds.rule: the Coordinator's choice (Oct 22): training = the first 120 seeds of dataset v2's training list (docs/eval/dataset-v2-freeze.json on #194, groups in listed order, less v2's 24 validation seeds, and less 2014 and 4054, excluded there for engine defects, C7; neither is reached), so the tactical set lines up with the broadcast set by seed; validation = v2freeze's 24 validation seeds exactly (docs/eval/finetune-v2freeze/validation-set.json); each seed keeps its v2 overrides

test_set.rule: the reserved test seeds with their own drawn parameters, no overrides (ninety/render/splits.py); views are not an override and leave the broadcast byte-identical

render.gl: training and validation: the pod's GPU (Chromium on the NVIDIA driver, refusing software GL), after a determinism check on the pod (one seed rendered twice in fresh browsers, every file of the clip and its views byte-identical); test: software GL (SwiftShader) on the same pod's CPUs, as every test set so far
render.driver: infra/pod/render.py from PR #194 with the views pass-through and the sealed failure reports, copied to the pod; its sha256 goes in the manifest

checks.per_clip: ninety.render.checks.check_clip on the clip: the broadcast's checks, every view's own checks (contract, projection, feet in boxes, labels), streams_agree and views_see_the_ball; and no dead-ball cut
checks.rule: a clip that fails any check is excluded and listed with its report; it is not re-rendered and no other seed replaces it, except a clip lost to the machine (a crashed worker, a black frame from GPU memory), which is rendered once more

machine: one rented RunPod pod, a 48 GB GPU (RTX A6000, L40S or RTX 6000 Ada) with 32 or more vCPU, deleted after the outputs are back on the Mac and checked against the manifest. Only synthetic renders go to it (AGENTS.md, vision models)
